title: QGIS workflows and connector status
description: Explore QGIS workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

SoftwareUpcoming

QGIS project

QGIS

QGIS is an open-source geographic information system for spatial analysis, mapping and extensible geoprocessing.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Assemble a spatial dataset

Use the approved coordinate reference system and source layers. In the intended QGIS preview, assemble a spatial dataset; the visible result is a mapped dataset with the selected geometry and attributes visible. Review location, units, topology and source currency before accepting or exporting it.

Run a geoprocessing analysis

Start from the prepared spatial features and analysis parameters. In the intended QGIS preview, run a geoprocessing analysis; the visible result is a result layer that exposes the measured pattern or transformation. Review method, edge cases and geographic coverage before accepting or exporting it.

Publish a reviewed map

Begin with the reviewed symbology, labels and metadata. In the intended QGIS preview, publish a reviewed map; the visible result is a controlled map package with provenance and extent attached. Review legibility, attribution and export settings before accepting or exporting it.
